title: Betanin mitigates vancomycin-induced acute kidney injury in mice and molecular docking indicated inhibition of STAT3 phosphorylation.
authors: Alrshedi, Haifa; Zaitone, Sawsan A; Alshaman, Reem; Helal, Mohamed A; Alattar, Abdullah; Alshammari, Sarah A; Bedaiwi, Hibah S; Sroor, Ghiadaa K; Alnasser, Ibtisam R; Ghabban, Abduallh J; Zayed, Eman Serry; Alatawy, Roba; Khodeer, Dina M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甜菜苷减轻万古霉素诱导的急性肾损伤，分子对接仅用于评估STAT3磷酸化抑制，核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a common, complicated disorder affecting hospitalized and critically ill patients. The signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (STAT3) is associated with the progress of AKI. Betanin is a natural betacyanin with multiple biological activities. The contribution of STAT3 in vancomycin-induced AKI and possible protection by betanin were investigated in this study. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) studies were done to test the probability of inhibition of STAT3 phosphorylation by betanin. Further, the experiment included eighteen male albino mice were assigned as (i) saline group, (ii) AKI control group (received vancomycin 200 mg/kg) by intraperitoneal injection for 14 doses, and (iii) vancomycin + betanin (50 mg/kg) group. Serum urea and creatinine were measured. Frozen kidneys were used for measuring inflammatory markers, whereas formalin-fixed kidneys were cut into sections to prepare specimens stained with hematoxylin and eosin. Molecular docking showed that betanin can hinder STAT3 phosphorylation. Serum urea and creatinine were found elevated in the AKI group versus the saline group; but reduced in the vancomycin + betanin group. Further, histopathological examination indicated tubular degeneration and interstitial inflammation that was mitigated by betanin. Betanin attenuated vancomycin-induced AKI, enhanced kidney function parameters, and retained the integrity of renal histological structures. These effects were, at least partly, facilitated via inhibiting the phosphorylation of the upregulated STAT3. These results open an avenue to fully test the effect and mechanism of betanin in various models of kidney injuries.
abstract_zh: 急性肾损伤（AKI）是一种常见且复杂的疾病，影响住院及危重患者。信号转导与转录激活因子-3（STAT3）与AKI的进展相关。甜菜苷是一种具有多种生物活性的天然甜菜色素。本研究探讨了STAT3在万古霉素诱导的AKI中的作用，以及甜菜苷可能的保护效应。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟（MDS）研究，评估甜菜苷抑制STAT3磷酸化的可能性。进一步实验中，将十八只雄性白化小鼠分为（i）生理盐水组，（ii）AKI对照组（腹腔注射万古霉素200 mg/kg，共14剂），及（iii）万古霉素+甜菜苷（50 mg/kg）组。检测血清尿素和肌酐水平。冷冻肾脏用于测量炎症标志物，而福尔马林固定的肾脏则切片制备苏木精-伊红染色标本。分子对接显示甜菜苷可阻碍STAT3磷酸化。与生理盐水组相比，AKI组血清尿素和肌酐水平升高；但在万古霉素+甜菜苷组中则降低。此外，组织病理学检查显示肾小管变性和间质炎症，而甜菜苷可缓解这些变化。甜菜苷减轻了万古霉素诱导的AKI，改善了肾功能参数，并保持了肾脏组织结构的完整性。这些效应至少部分通过抑制上调的STAT3磷酸化来实现。这些结果为全面测试甜菜苷在各种肾损伤模型中的作用及机制开辟了途径。
